answers.q1: Cargo (Rust; rust-version 1.96 in Cargo.toml). Install dependencies from the repo root with: cargo fetch
answers.q2: cargo test --workspace (CI also runs cargo test --verbose --workspace --features unstable-index, and cargo test --verbose --workspace --features pcre2)
answers.q3: cargo test --test integration regression:: (tests/regression.rs is the module `regression` inside the integration test binary declared in Cargo.toml, so it has no standalone target)
answers.q4: cargo fmt --all --check (the rustfmt job in .github/workflows/ci.yml). CI also has a docs check: RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --no-deps --document-private-items --workspace. CI does not run clippy.
answers.q5: Cargo.lock and fuzz/Cargo.lock are generated by Cargo and should be updated by running cargo, not by hand. There is no vendored directory. benchsuite/runs/ holds recorded benchmark output data. The man page and shell completions are generated at build time into target/, not checked in.
